use default

swap[T](values: LIST[T], i: int, j: int) is
    (values[i], values[j]) = (values[j], values[i])
si

cocktail_sort[T: Ghul.Comparable[T]](values: LIST[T]) is
    let low mut = 0
    let high mut = values.count - 2

    while low <= high do
        let new_high mut = low
        let new_low mut = high

        for i in low..high + 1 do
            if values[i] > values[i + 1] then
                swap(values, i, i + 1)
                new_high = i
            fi
        od

        high = new_high

        let i mut = high

        while i >= low do
            if values[i] > values[i + 1] then
                swap(values, i, i + 1)
                new_low = i
            fi

            i = i - 1
        od

        low = new_low + 1
    od
si
